stops.title: Di Bɔd
stops.caption: Nyu, wi de fɔlo ɔp, i kɔnvat.
stops.speech: Di sol paiplain na wan bɔd. Pɔsin de muv frɔm nyu, to wi de fɔlo ɔp, to i kɔnvat, ɛn di kɔlɔ sho aw let di kɔntakt de.

stops.title: Muv Sɔmbɔdi
stops.caption: Drag am, ɔ opin ɛn ɔpdet.
stops.speech: Drag wan kad go di nɛks layn, ɔ opin am fɔ rɛkɔd wetin apin ɛn sɛt di nɛks fɔlo ɔp de.
